description.value:
Requirements Your natural light is kindled.

You release all the light within your body in a dazzling burst. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Then, your natural light is extinguished, and you can't rekindle it again for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] until the start of your next turn.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded] until the start of your next turn and dazzled for 1 minute. The creature can spend an Interact action rubbing its eyes to end the blinded condition.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 minute and dazzled for 1 hour.
